recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future modernization of the old genetics profile/example presentation or non-semantic typo cleanup should be handled separately from FHIR-11138.
issue_request: FHIR-11138 was a Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics request to include a double cousin relationship in the FHIR-core terminology area. The accepted resolution said to represent the relationship through pedigree information using existing cousin semantics, with the genetics sibling extension and an example showing the additional pedigree links.
initial_application: Commit e3493bf5ac23399d1e3a8102b6ada656126cc97e explicitly applied #11138 by adding the double-cousin List example, sibling relationship value set, and genetics sibling extension/profile support. The current core source still has the double-cousin example and FamilyMemberHistory example link.
additional_context: FamilyMemberHistory and List remain active resources in source/fhir.ini. Later R5 cleanup removed concrete extension definitions from core, and the same canonical family-member-history-genetics-sibling extension and sibling-relationship-codes value set now exist in the FHIR Extension Pack source. Community searches found tracker/commit bot mentions and later usage questions, but no conflicting WG decision or reversal.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Adding a double-cousin code would contradict the issue resolution, and re-adding the moved sibling extension to core would duplicate Extension Pack source of truth.
